items.title: With R^1 killed and curve fibres, the structure pushforward is S-flat and commutes with base change
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)

items.difficulty_reason: For a commutative diagram of schemes X -> Y -> S with X -> S flat, f : X -> Y proper, all Y-fibres of dimension <= 1, and R^1 f_* O_X = 0, the lemma proves f_* O_X is flat over S and its formation commutes with arbitrary base change S' -> S. The retained proof is written: reduce to Y, S affine, S = Spec(A); relative flatness of f_* O_X is checked on global sections H^0(X, O_X) over A (the parenthetical some details omitted covers only this affine-to-sheaf translation); the chapter's globally-generated-vanishing lemma then gives H^1(X, O_X tensor_A M) = 0 for every A-module M; flatness of O_X over A turns the long exact sequence machinery into exactness of M |-> H^0(X, O_X tensor_A M), which commutes with direct sums (Cohomology, lemma quasi-separated-cohomology-colimit); the functor is therefore M |-> M tensor_A H^0(X, O_X) (the author flags the identification as an exercise in Eilenberg-Watts style bookkeeping), proving flatness; base change commutation is the same displayed tensor identity after A -> A'. Retained author proof at lines 21208-21232.
